comment: Package kit hints for the File server (docs/package-testing.md «Module kit file»). No demo data (its folders live on a real SMB server): the seed makes a group, a server, a folder entry visible to that group only, two public links, a favourite and a listing through the module's own API. The server is 127.0.0.1:9 and is never contacted: backendEnv points the package's gateway at the kit's fake (fakes/python-smbgate → fakes/smbgate-fake.py), an in-memory read-only share on the gateway's private socket — no SMB server, no domain controller, nothing on the network. With it the folder routes, the public link /d/<token> (also the shell list an anonymous visitor of that page gets: manifest web.publicPaths) and previews answer for real; writes answer 403 ACCESS_DENIED (read-only share), thumbnails 415. «Доступ» (AD groups, NTFS) stays switched off (404 DRIVE_ACCESS_DISABLED): it needs a real Active Directory. The AD directory is a linked package (demo directory): it shows the folder access groups (sg_…) and refuses to change them; the File server lends it its AD connection and the stored AD passwords (real AD only). Tasks attach File server files through the browser-side module API (provideModule), nothing on the server.
sessionsOnlyWhy: «Доступ» changes Active Directory and NTFS as the person's own domain account: API tokens are refused there (403 FA_NO_TOKENS, drive/access/routes.js), whatever their scopes
appendOnlyWhy: the activity log records the kit's own folder listings, file views and link visits (drive.audit): its rows may only grow between snapshots
